product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP and AI content authoring to help enterprises train and upskill their workforces at scale.

employee_band.notes: Company-size range reported on its LinkedIn profile.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists West Orange, New Jersey as headquarters. The website labels it North America HQ and separately identifies Chennai, India as Corporate & Technology HQ.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows learning-industry, product and marketing content rather than qualifying engineering posts about building Disprz.

public_docs.notes: Public resources include a developer portal, an API catalogue and a REST integration guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists AI Content Operations Intern in Chennai with an application option. This is a GenAI content-operations internship, not an AI engineering position.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft's customer story explicitly identifies Azure OpenAI as supporting Disprz's personalization.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II attestation, ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn dates the round May 26, 2023; the company's public announcement of the $30 million Series C is dated August 7, 2023.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the 2023 Series C, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers board lists no qualifying titles. The inspected account-executive and BDR postings explicitly say they are no longer accepting applications; an unconfirmed third-party mirror still displays a BDR listing.

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced Autonomous Enablement OS on September 28, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Anand Venkatesan's profile states he has headed engineering at Disprz since March 2026; the company lists him as Senior Vice President & Head of Engineering.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A business-operations posting explicitly names both in the company's GTM technology stack.
